author: petr1petr
body:
what do you mean by "best"?

best as easiest? best as most fun? best as for learning about the game?

I loved starting as mage - you will learn about elements its passives and you can also learn about stats - buffs, debuffs, what is def, what is res, what is M1 (penetration) and such.

once you are T10, you want to check other classes, to see how melee works, how to work with ward, what is steadfast and how it affects you, what is swash and if you like it..

A lot of people will tell you to go summoner classline from T7 - "it is easy" - yeah, it is so easy, that you will learn nothing about mechanics and on T10, you will be asking for basic info - nothing will push you towards learning about game. Thats why I dont recommend this way for your first char. it is easier to learn as you go, instead of exploring everything later on.

dont listen to "summoner is #1 player - so it is a best class" - not true - it only means that the guy spends a lot of time in game. in top 10, there is only 1 summoner. 

on T11, people switch classes for different content - so it is really good idea to test them and see what suits you. Dont make decission based on equips you drop - you have to enjoy the class you play - otherwise, you wont be able to play to for too long, the game will be boring for you.. 

so just test it, or check some vids on youtube and see what looks good to you. even if it is summoner :D 

have fun

author: Lwessh
body: Currently I have 2 accounts; my main one and another one that I'm leveling up now (currently 9*). On both I've played Valhallan from the beginning and it was a great experience with practically no difficulties. In my opinion, Beowulf Auriga/Hydros is the best in the game.

author: Ok-Resource8121
body:
T1–T7: Valhalla.

T7–T9: Summoner.

T10: Summoner and Valhalla. Valhalla can be the best for raids if you have the Blue Dog. Thief is top 3, Mage is top 4, while Gods and Warrior aren’t really worth it until you have better gear.

T11: Gods and Valhalla. Gods perform well in all content. Valhalla has stronger turn-1 damage, but isn’t the best for Endless. Summoner is by far the best for Endless, and it’s not even close.
So in my opinion, the Valhalla path is the safest choice since it’s always in the top 3. That said, in the end, all classes perform very well across all content
